name: Guild Member
description:
You are an Apprentice in one of Guildford's many Guilds.

When you gain this ability, choose one Guildford-made equipment item costing 3 Treasure or less. You own that item, and it is modified to prominently feature your guild's insignia.

You may spend 20 Treasure or 50 XP, once, to become a Journeyman within the Guild. When you do, your base MP increases by 1, and you can always acquire equipment items costing up to 1 Treasure as if they were gratuiti. These purchases are made with Guild funds, on behalf of the Guild, and cannot be sold for personal profit without forfeiting your membership with the Guild.

If you are already a Journeyman, you may spend 50 treasure or 100 XP, once, to become a Master within the Guild. When you do, your base MP increases by 2, and you can acquire equipment items costing up to 2 Treasure as if they were gratuiti, as above.

Regardless of which status level you have achieved within the Guild, at the end of each Quest, you must pay 10% of the treasure you acquired on the Quest - rounded up - to the Guild.

Describe the Guild and why you joined it.
